metadata.title: Preliminary Summary of Harmonic Readout and c=1 Area Sweep in an AB Two-Body Closed Phase System
metadata.description: This V3 release updates the AB two-body harmonic readout and c=1 area sweep summary while keeping the original scope and claims unchanged. V3 applies the fermion-like recoil map to chi_read as the scattering-matrix factor q_out_factor. The result confirms that the harmonic acceleration-like readout frame and the chi-tau surface remain evaluable in the AB two-body closed phase system. The paper still does not claim a native inverse-area, inverse-law, or inverse-square-law derivation.
metadata.notes: This V3 update keeps the AB two-body acceleration-readout claims unchanged. It only replaces the recoil readout implementation with chi_read = q_out_factor * chi_pass, where q_out_factor = T - R and the complete-recoil limit gives q_out_factor = -1.
